WITH posts AS (
SELECT CASE WHEN q.IS_NOTICE = 'Y' THEN 'NOTICE' ELSE 'QNA' END AS postType, q.QNA_NO AS postNo, q.QNA_TITLE AS title, q.QNA_CTT AS content, q.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NAME AS writerName, u.ROLE AS writerRole, q.QNA_CREATED AS createdAt, NVL(q.QNA_HIT,0) AS hit, q.QNA_STATUS AS qnaStatus, q.IS_NOTICE AS isNotice, q.ANS_CTT AS ansCtt, q.ANS_AT AS ansAt, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS reviewRating, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS orderNo FROM QNA_BOARD q JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = q.USER_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT 'REVIEW' AS postType, r.REVIEW_NO AS postNo, r.REVIEW_TITLE AS title, r.REVIEW_CTT AS content, r.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NAME AS writerName, u.ROLE AS writerRole, r.REVIEW_CREATED AS createdAt, NVL(r.REVIEW_HIT,0) AS hit, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS qnaStatus, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS isNotice, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ansCtt, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS ansAt, r.REVIEW_RATING AS reviewRating, r.ORDER_NO AS orderNo FROM REVIEW_BOARD r JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = r.USER_ID ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE 1=1
AND p.postType = #{kind}
AND p.createdAt >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND p.createdAt < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND UPPER(p.writerRole) = 'USER'
AND UPPER(p.writerRole) = 'ADMIN'
AND UPPER(p.writerRole) = UPPER(#{role})
AND ( p.title LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.content LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.userId LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.writerName LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' )
AND p.title LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%'
AND (p.userId LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.writerName LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')
AND p.content LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%'

WITH posts AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN q.IS_NOTICE = 'Y' THEN 'NOTICE' ELSE 'QNA' END AS postType, q.QNA_NO AS postNo, q.QNA_TITLE AS title, q.QNA_CTT AS content, q.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NAME AS writerName, u.ROLE AS writerRole, q.QNA_CREATED AS createdAt, NVL(q.QNA_HIT,0) AS hit, q.QNA_STATUS AS qnaStatus, q.IS_NOTICE AS isNotice, q.ANS_CTT AS ansCtt, q.ANS_AT AS ansAt, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS reviewRating, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS orderNo FROM QNA_BOARD q JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = q.USER_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT 'REVIEW' AS postType, r.REVIEW_NO AS postNo, r.REVIEW_TITLE AS title, r.REVIEW_CTT AS content, r.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NAME AS writerName, u.ROLE AS writerRole, r.REVIEW_CREATED AS createdAt, NVL(r.REVIEW_HIT,0) AS hit, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS qnaStatus, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS isNotice, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ansCtt, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS ansAt, r.REVIEW_RATING AS reviewRating, r.ORDER_NO AS orderNo FROM REVIEW_BOARD r JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = r.USER_ID )
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.postType, p.postNo, p.title, p.userId, p.writerName, p.writerRole, TO_CHAR(p.createdAt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAtStr, p.hit, p.qnaStatus, p.isNotice, p.reviewRating, p.orderNo, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY p.createdAt DESC, p.postNo DESC) AS rn FROM posts p WHERE 1=1
AND p.postType = #{kind}
AND p.createdAt >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND p.createdAt < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND UPPER(p.writerRole) = 'USER'
AND UPPER(p.writerRole) = 'ADMIN'
AND UPPER(p.writerRole) = UPPER(#{role})
AND ( p.title LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.content LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.userId LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.writerName LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' )
AND p.title LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%'
AND (p.userId LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.writerName LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')
AND p.content LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%'
) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY rn
